capabilities.claude_capability: Agents reference exact commands and scripts.
capabilities.target_capability: The canonical command registry labels every agent executable, advisory, or governance and binds executable agents to validated commands.
acceptance: All executable agents expose validated entrypoints.

capabilities.claude_capability: High-value skills are self-contained directories with references.
capabilities.target_capability: Twenty high-value packages are machine-registered and anchored in one canonical package document so runtime composition does not duplicate policy.
acceptance: High-value executable skills have canonical packages.

capabilities.claude_capability: Parallel agent execution with loose text handoffs.
capabilities.target_capability: Schema-valid bounded DAG, evidence binding, budgets, decisions and consumed handoffs.
acceptance: No new tool bypasses runtime contracts.

capabilities.target_capability: Canonical seoctl registry exposes 67 governed commands, and root help derives all 21 families from that canonical metadata.
acceptance: Every command supports help, JSON and stable exit codes.
Command docs are generated from metadata.

capabilities.claude_capability: Live GSC queries and aggregate totals.
capabilities.target_capability: Production-shaped scoped GSC query and aggregate code contracts exist; authorized live provider evidence is incomplete.
capabilities.next_action: Run the authorized redacted GSC smoke contract with owner-supplied credentials; do not change code-verified status without that evidence.
capabilities.rollback_trigger: Reopen code remediation if the scoped GSC connector, dimensionless totals, redaction, or bounded query tests regress; never promote without an authorized live receipt.

capabilities.target_capability: GA4 Data API code contract exists with property and metric validation; authorized live provider evidence is incomplete.
capabilities.next_action: Run the authorized redacted GA4 smoke contract with a test property and owner-supplied credentials.
capabilities.rollback_trigger: Reopen code remediation if GA4 property or metric validation, error redaction, or report contract tests regress; never promote without an authorized live receipt.

capabilities.target_capability: Live PageSpeed adapter with shared URL safety.
Current and historical CrUX commands are code verified; authorized live history evidence remains incomplete.
